actions.action: Changed Status from To Do to In Progress and closed details.
Verified the card moved and counts changed from 3/2 to 2/3.

observations: Immediately after the change, the task appeared in In Progress.
After reload, it returned to To Do and counts reverted to 3 To Do / 2 In Progress.
notes: The status transition is not persisted, so the refreshed Kanban layout is stale.
